children: Stanley Black & Decker agreed to sell its Excel Industries turf-care equipment business to Bad Boy Mowers.
The company said Friday that the deal, whose financial terms weren't disclosed, would focus its portfolio on its biggest brands.

"The sale of Excel further refines our portfolio and unlocks greater shareholder value by concentrating resources on the areas where we see the most compelling opportunities to grow and win," Chief Executive Chris Nelson said.
The deal isn't expected to be dilutive to adjusted earnings per share, the company said, and that Excel's results will be classified as continuing operations until the deal closes.
The Excel business, which includes the Hustler brand of lawn mowers, is expected to generate around $300 million in revenue in the current fiscal year, the company said.
